overview.value: La storia parla di Ichijou e Kirisaki. Le loro famiglie (precisamente lui Yakuza, lei Gangsters) sono in guerra per il controllo del business, ma i due leader vorrebbero andare d'accordo poiché se la guerra non si ferma ci saranno molte vittime. Per questo motivo i due leader decidono che i loro rispettivi nipoti, Ichijou e Kirisaki, dovranno diventare amanti e sposarsi, in modo che le loro famiglie vadano d'accordo l'una con l'altra. I due ragazzi diventeranno amanti ufficiali e le loro famiglie andranno d'accordo? O continueranno a lottare e creare molti problemi?

translations.title: Nisekoi
translations.overview: Raku Ichijo is an average high school student. He also happens to be the sole heir to the head of a Yakuza Family called the Shuei-gumi. 10 years ago, Raku made a promise… a secret promise with a girl he met. They promised one another that they will “get married when they reunite.” Since then, Raku never let go of the pendant the girl gave him.

極道一家「集英組」のひとり息子だが、ごく普通の高校生・一条楽。 彼は、10年前、仲良くなった女の子と「再会したら結婚する」という約束をし、 その時に貰ったペンダントを肌身離さずに持っていた。 そんなある日、楽のクラスにやって来た転校生の美少女・桐崎千棘。 最初の出会いから相性最悪で、事ある毎にケンカを繰り返す楽と千棘だが、 とある事情から二人は恋人を演じることに。 恋心を抱く、クラスメイトの小野寺小咲の事を気にしつつも、 恋人のフリを続ける楽。 「偽恋物語」の行く末やいかに！？
translations.tagline: ウソツキは、恋の始まり。

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis:
Miyamoto Ruri loses her glasses at school, but even without them she clearly sees what Raku and Onodera Kosaki mean to each other.

Ruku's father asks the gang to help out at a friend's shrine on New Year's Day. As it turns out something very bad is haunting Raku or so the girls are led to believe.

Lately Tachibana Marika leaves school early, making Raku wonder. When he and Chitoge visit the local fast food restaurant they find out why.

On New Year's Day the whole gang unexpectedly visits Raku's mansion. After a feast Chitoge craves some non-Japanese sweets, that unbeknownst to them happen to contain alcohol.

The bath at Raku's mansion is not working properly, so he visits the local public bath, where Chitoge also happens to turn up, along with Marika, her maid Honda, Kosaki, and her sister Haru.

The girls visit the hot springs up in the mountains. Their tied-together clothes get catapulted into the mens' hot spring where Raku is trying to relax for once.
